# JUDO Meta RDBMS

> EMF metamodel for relational database schemas with incremental schema evolution tracking, Epsilon-based validation, and Eclipse/OSGi packaging.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4+ with Tycho 4.0.13
- 6 modules (model, test, OSGi bundle, OSGi integration test, Eclipse feature, update site)
- EMF (Ecore) metamodel with Epsilon ETL/EVL transformations and MWE2 code generation
- Eclipse plugin and standalone OSGi bundle packaging
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview with metamodel and runtime flow diagrams
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with build commands, architecture, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, code generation, build lifecycle, and submission guidelines
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): Git branching strategy, version numbering, and CI/CD workflow diagrams

## Modules — Core

- [model/pom.xml](model/pom.xml): Eclipse plugin containing the Ecore metamodel definitions, EMF-generated code, Epsilon validation/transformation scripts, and hand-written runtime support
- [model-test/pom.xml](model-test/pom.xml): JUnit 5 tests for EVL validation, utility functions, incremental transformation, and execution context

## Modules — OSGi

- [osgi/pom.xml](osgi/pom.xml): Repackages the model as an OSGi bundle with dynamic model loading via bundle tracker
- [osgi-itest/pom.xml](osgi-itest/pom.xml): Karaf/Pax Exam integration tests verifying OSGi service registration and bundle lifecycle

## Modules — Eclipse Packaging

- [feature/feature.xml](feature/feature.xml): Eclipse feature definition for P2 installation
- [site/category.xml](site/category.xml): Eclipse update site compiling all versions for distribution

## Optional

- [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): CI/CD build pipeline
